ValidationRule.description: Prevent users from modifying any logistic fields on completed/cancelled drives
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(DriveStatus__c = 'Complete',DriveStatus__c = 'Cancel'), Not($User.FirstName & ' ' & $User.LastName = 'Automated Process'), OR( ISCHANGED(Drive_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Parent_Template_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Start_Time__c), ISCHANGED(End_Time__c), ISCHANGED(Drive_Site__c), ISCHANGED(Anticipated_Registered_Donors__c), ISCHANGED(WB_Projected_Procedures__c), ISCHANGED(X2RBC_Projected_Procedures__c), ISCHANGED(Platelet_Projected_Procedures__c), ISCHANGED(Plasma_Pheresis_Projected_Procedures__c), ISCHANGED(Number_of_2RBC_Assets__c), ISCHANGED(Number_of_Plasma_Assets__c), ISCHANGED(Number_of_Platelet_Assets__c), ISCHANGED(Slot_Generator__c), ISCHANGED(APT_Required__c), ISCHANGED(APT_Quantity__c), ISCHANGED(Red_Cross_Volunteer_Required__c), ISCHANGED(Red_Cross_Volunteer_Quantity__c) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Drive logistic fields cannot be modified on a completed/cancelled drive
